title: United Airlines system outage impacts departing flights
excerpt: United Airlines is experiencing a system outage that is disrupting departing flights, following a recent nationwide FAA ground stop.
body_html:
United Airlines is facing a technical outage that has caused disruptions to its departing flights. The issue comes less than a week after a separate nationwide ground stop issued by the Federal Aviation Administration, which was triggered by a problem involving air traffic control communications and radar.

United Airlines stated that it is actively working to restore normal operations as quickly as possible. However, the airline has not yet provided detailed information regarding the specific cause of the outage or how many flights or passengers have been affected by the disruption.
